notes: Test adapter, not production Doom.step performance or production API acceptance.
Exact original command bytes only; no native gameplay states supplied to EVM.
Local infrastructure limits are explicit CLI settings; compiler/hardfork/game rules and WAD identity remain pinned.
Stream chain hex and receipt arrays to disk; restore owned Anvil through --load-state; preserve mined receipts separately from pruned local history.

Observation-only generated clone logs provenance without changing draw guards/arithmetic. Captures invoke DoomGame.render on a temporary memory copy and emit standard Frame receipts. No native rendering, UI or progression.
Render memory state changes are reported; saved gameplay is checked unchanged after every capture. Full DSG1 compared at every tic.
Gas includes observation events and storage; wall time includes local RPC/mining and comparison. Deployment/startup reported separately.
